== Description ==
The '''Raider 2''' was an [[Area 51]] [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared during the [[Area 51 Event]]. It was the second raider to appear after the [[Raider 1]].

The '''Raider 2''' had the same speed as the [[Raider 1]], but had even more health. It carried an ice gun which could be used to freeze specific towers with the ''Ice Gun'' ability. Towers around the target would also be splashed, resulting in several towers being stunned for an extended period of time. 

== Appearance ==
The '''Raider 2''' had blue skin and wore dark grey armor, with black gloves. It had dark navy legs and had an ice tank on its back, possibly as ammunition for the ice gun it wielded. The '''Raider 2''' also had a drooling zombie face.

== Strategy ==
*Similar to the [[Raider 1]], try to use the [[Scout]] to distract its attack away from your main towers.
*When it is charging up its ice gun, the '''Raider 2''' becomes immobile, allowing any tower that is not frozen to target it.
*Due to the splash effect of the '''Raider 2's''' attack, it is best not to place your towers close together. This is because if one tower is hit, they will all become frozen.
*The [[Pyromancer]] does not deal any extra damage against the '''Raider 2''', it will simply just slow it down like any other [[Enemies|enemy]].
*The '''Raider 2''' will not target the [[Farm]], [[Sentry]], [[Turret]], [[Military Base]] or spawned [[units]].
**However, the splash effect of the '''Raider 2's''' ice gun may still hit the [[Sentry]] and [[Turret]].

== Trivia ==
*The '''Raider 2''' was a reference to the ''Storm Area 51, They Can't Stop All of Us'' event where masses of people would have raided the ''Nevada Test and Training Range''.
*The gun used by the '''Raider 2''' is the {{RLinkC|108875237|Sapphire Rapid Fire Shocker}} from the Roblox catalog.
